meta.source: Charity Commission for England and Wales, register of charities full extract (publicextract.charity, tab-separated)
meta.licence_checked: footer of the full-register-download page, 2026-10-03: "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated"
meta.attribution: Contains Charity Commission data, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
meta.method: Daily extract; rows whose contact postcode is in E14 (main charities and linked subsidiaries, registered and removed). No coordinates: positions are ONSPD postcode centres.
fields_dropped: gift aid, land, insolvency and administration flags
meta.caution: The address is the contact address the charity gives, not where it works. For small charities it is often a trustee's home or an accountant: do not read it as an occupant (same lesson as SE-1, registered offices).
meta.membership: in_box: the source coordinate lies in the box, or (no source coordinate) the ONSPD centre of the postcode does; in_e14: postcode district E14. Kept: either.
